photos.description: Intel headquarters at 2200 Mission College Boulevard in Santa Clara, California. At the time this photo was taken in 2023, the Robert Noyce Building was wrapped with a temporary poster honoring the life and career of Intel co-founder Gordon Moore, who had recently died in March.  Photographed by use
